test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year was the National Human Rights Commission established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1993**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) was established in India on **12 October 1993** under the Protection of **Human Rights Act, 1993.**
 
• Its main purpose is to protect and promote human rights, including** civil, political, economic, social, and cultural rights** guaranteed by the Constitution and international treaties.
 
• The NHRC consists of a **chairperson (who is a retired Chief Justice of India)**, members of the judiciary, human rights experts, and representatives of minorities and marginalized groups.
 
• The NHRC investigates violations of human rights, recommends actions to the government, conducts awareness programs, and a**dvises on laws and policies** related to human rights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is composed of a Chairperson and other members is as follows.
 
 
• **Chairman**: A person who has been Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, or a Judge of the Supreme Court will be the chairperson of the NHRC. 
 
• **First member**: Judge of High court
 
• **Second member:** Judge of Supreme Court
 
• **Other Two members**: Persons having knowledge in the matter of Human rights
 
• Special Invitee to Statutory Full Commission - ;National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
 
• **Deemed members:** Chairpersons of the following commissions:
 
 
• National Commission for Minorities
 
• National Commission for STs
 
• National Commission for SCs
 
• National Commission for Women
 
• National Commission for Backward Classes
 
• Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities
 
• Chairperson National Commission for Protection of Child Rights.
